text:
**My pick for a slim Qi2 power bank for the iPhone 17: the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K).** If you'd rather have more capacity and faster charging, get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

**Slimmest overall: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, Qi2 15W)**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, and 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. It also runs cooler than the competition.
- It's listed at $54.99, and the page shows the iPhone 17 series as compatible at 15W.
- Buy: [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Source: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Slim with more power: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, Qi2.2 25W)**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195 g, with 25W wireless charging on iPhone 16 and later, 45W wired, and a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable.
- Android Central lists it at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU. Macworld calls it an "equal slimmest" 10K pick.
- Buy: I don't have a direct product link from these results. See the retailer buttons in [Android Central's roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) or [Macworld's guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104 g, which Android Central says makes it the thinnest and lightest of the group.
- The catch is that Android Central lists wireless charging at only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- Android Central lists it at $52.99–$69.99 at Amazon. I don't have a direct product link, so use the retailer buttons in the [Android Central roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

**Things to know**
- 5K banks usually recharge a phone only about 60–75%, while 10K banks give roughly 1.5–2 charges (Macworld). If you want a full charge or two, go with the 10K.
- 25W wireless only works on the iPhone 16 and later, which includes your 17. Phones such as the iPhone 15 and older get 15W.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging. Anker notes that cases over about 2.5 mm may weaken the connection.
- If you want a faster 10K bank and don't mind a thicker one, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 (Qi2.2, 25W wireless, 45W wired) is $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52 per [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). The page doesn't list its thickness. That page's buy link is an affiliate link, so I haven't used it, and the code may change.
